svg.title: External Configuration Store
svg.desc: External Configuration Store. Keep configuration out of the deployment package, in a central store read at runtime. Step 1, Settings baked in: Settings and passwords are baked into each image: a build per environment and a rebuild per change. Step 2, One image everywhere: Build 57 runs everywhere. At start each instance reads its label's settings and fetches its secrets. Step 3, Change at runtime: Payment timeout 2 s → 3 s in the store: version 8, audited, live in seconds without a redeploy. Step 4, Safe to depend on: The store goes down, yet instances run, and even restart, on a cached copy. Changes ship in stages.

g.text: Settings and passwords are baked into each image: a build per environment and a rebuild per change.
Build 57 runs everywhere. At start each instance reads its label's settings and fetches its secrets.
Payment timeout 2 s → 3 s in the store: version 8, audited, live in seconds without a redeploy.
The store goes down, yet instances run, and even restart, on a cached copy. Changes ship in stages.
